directConsumerSites.source:
Model tiers

Every model a rule can be given, one record per row. The order column ranks all records together: the lower the order, the stronger the record. A category's tier with the largest order is the one a rule gets, and escalation moves to the next smaller order.

Rules

Manage built-in rules and edit the project's AGENTS.md. A rule's order sets the order AGENTS.md renders the rule sections in: rules with an order first, from the smallest, then the others in catalog order.

supportedLocaleText.en: Minimum relevance required to return a result. Unset uses 3. Raising it filters more weak matches; lowering it admits more results. The threshold adapts to the library’s indexed content.
supportedLocaleText.zh-CN: 返回结果所需的最低相关性。未设置时为 3。调高会过滤更多弱匹配；调低可返回更多结果。阈值随库内已索引内容调整。
supportedLocaleText.ja: 結果を返す最低関連度です。未設定時は 3 です。上げると弱い一致を除き、下げるとより多くの結果を認めます。しきい値はライブラリの索引内容に応じて調整されます。
supportedLocaleText.ko: 결과를 반환하는 데 필요한 최소 관련성입니다. 미설정 시 3입니다. 높이면 약한 일치를 더 제외하고 낮추면 더 많은 결과를 허용합니다. 기준은 라이브러리의 색인 내용에 맞춰 조정됩니다.
supportedLocaleText.fr: Pertinence minimale pour renvoyer un résultat. La valeur par défaut est 3. L’augmenter élimine davantage de correspondances faibles ; la réduire en admet plus. Le seuil s’adapte au contenu indexé de la bibliothèque.
